resources.string: Applied the next time you connect
How the tunnel behaves with the system

Many proxies block the checks Android, Windows and macOS use to detect internet access, so the system shows “no internet” even when there is. ProxyUCI answers them while the proxy works; if it stops responding, the warning appears.
Open the local network without the proxy

Sites on the network you are on (such as those on uci.cu) are looked up in that network's DNS and, if they are internal, opened directly, without going through the proxy or Other Country: the proxy usually does not open them. For other internal sites, add a domain rule with the “Direct” exit.
The browsing MB the UCI gives your account
With UCI profiles, the quota is checked with the profile's username and password when the app opens and every few minutes while you are connected. It shows in Usage.
When reached, it disconnects so you do not use up the quota without noticing. You can connect anyway: it will not pause again until your usage drops below %1$d%.
Off, as in UCIProxy: the quota service certificate is signed by a UCI authority that systems do not recognize, and with verification on the check fails.
For testing with tools/test_cuotas.py. Empty: the UCI one.
To ask the proxy for public IPs by name

The UCI proxy rejects connections to an IP written as a number, but accepts the same destination with a name. These services give a name to any IP. They are tried in this order (drag to change it), starting with the one that worked last time; one the proxy rejects several times in a row is set aside for a few minutes.
Also try the IP as is
If no name works, the IP without a name is tried as a last resort.
Whoever provides the name learns which IPs are requested: do not use services you do not trust.
